justificativa: The candidate creates a separate `checks` job without `needs`, using `BUNDLE_WITHOUT=production`, with Audit, Lint, Brakeman in report mode (`--no-exit-on-warn`, as the issue asks) and Zeitwerk on SQLite with schema loaded. It adds the weekly `schedule` trigger running only the audit, skips the other jobs on that trigger, and leaves `test` with only the suite.
